title: SwissCat Visuals
description: A mod pack combining some optimizations mods with visuals addition that work on my computer and wish to share.
body:
A modpack made up of some mods, texture packs and shaders I use to play online or on my own.

if you wish to know who made what, please look under the dependencies of the version you have selecte, you will find a list of all mods, texture packs and shaders I have used and their respective creators.
